evidence.reason: The admission path only decorates the result after calling `status()` at line 114, and only when `action == "observed"`. The condition/reason is not persisted and `status()` is not shown revalidating the receipt, so a later direct status call can report normal completion while `verify_receipt(item)` would still fail. The identical-submission path may re-enter this block, but the status-path loss remains a minor correctness defect.
